title: Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data

entities.name: Protocol Data Handling
entities.description: General procedure for handling unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data in NAS communication.

entities.name: Unknown Protocol Data
entities.description: Condition where received protocol data is not recognized by the receiver.

entities.name: Unforeseen Protocol Data
entities.description: Condition where received protocol data is not expected in current protocol state or context.

entities.name: Erroneous Protocol Data
entities.description: Condition where received protocol data contains errors or inconsistencies.

relations.description: Protocol data handling procedure includes handling of unknown data conditions.
Protocol data handling procedure includes handling of unforeseen data conditions.
Protocol data handling procedure includes handling of erroneous data conditions.
